issue_context.title: Feature: Add "Install" toolbar button for certificate files
issue_context.body:
### What feature or improvement do you think would benefit Files?

Windows Explorer has a context menu entry for installing certificates (supports .cer, .crt, .pfx and .der as far as I know) which is loaded as a shell entry in Files. Since there is a toolbar button to quickly install fonts or inf files, having it for certificates would be nice too.

### Requirements

- This proposal will add an Install button to the toolbar for .cer, .crt, .pfx and .der files (similar to .inf and font files)

### Files Version

2.4.71.0

### Windows Version

Windows 11 22H2 10.0.22631.1825

### Comments

_No response_
